summary: Build workforce forecasts, dashboards, and gap analyses with practical people analytics training. Learn to plan with data and confidence.
lede: People analytics for workforce planning turns workforce data into practical decisions about staffing, capability, succession, and cost. This course helps you assess workforce demographics, turnover, vacancies, internal movement, skills gaps, and changing demand through structured supply and demand analysis. You will build forecasts, skills matrices, scenario tables, and leadership dashboards using Excel-based calculations. You will also learn how to connect workforce insights to hiring, development, internal mobility, and automation priorities, and present workforce plans that support conversations with finance, operations, and senior leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who need to turn workforce data into staffing, skills, and capacity decisions. It suits roles that manage HR reporting, headcount planning, talent supply, and workforce risk.
modules: People Analytics and Workforce Planning Context
Stakeholder Reviews and Workforce Action Plans
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of HR operations, workforce reporting, or talent planning. Familiarity with Excel and basic data interpretation will help you get the most from the calculations, scenario exercises, and dashboard work. No coding is required, and advanced statistics is covered at an applied level rather than an engineering level. If you already support headcount planning, talent reviews, succession planning, or HR reporting, you are ready for this course.
